critical_limitations: No observed candidate vote share by voting method has been verified for these 15 states. Do not infer it from party registration or general voting trends.
NCSL16 identifies when scanning is legally permitted, NOT the timing, content, or partisan composition of public result releases.
State-level law does not establish county-level publication times.
Operational watchpoints are hypotheses/risks, not certified 2026 reporting schedules.
No numerical mode weights, turnout allocations, partisan tilts or release timestamps have been fabricated.
